title: 专题：知识检索平台化（应用写一份知识源配置就有可用的检索：开源、托管、企业版都能用）
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic parent). Source: maintainer. Key words (maintainer, 2026-11-24, this session): 「专题 ② 知识检索平台化 也一起立」「需要拍板的事项 都同意」「这几个专题任务用fable 审核之后立卡」「目前开发的策略是按专题派」. Reviewed by an independent Fable pass before filing.
Batch-of: 4 epics filed together on 2026-11-24 (this one, #36990, #36996, cloud 「应用技能进入应用内 AI」).
Supersedes: the maintainer's 2026-11-15 positioning on #33933 (「知识库 根本还没开始开发」「目前不是本项目的重点」) and its cloud consequence cloud#4569; the earlier knowledge positioning in #4606 (engines by integration, no new open-core commitment, vector stores Enterprise) and the no-reconcile option in #4672. The decisions are written down in objectstack-ai/cloud#4960 and child 1 below.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：知识源变成受管理的元数据（Studio、MCP 可配置，有版本）；平台统一负责切分、同步与核对、按记录返回、按范围过滤；turso 和 pgvector 两个向量存储都在开源；开源运行时和 cloud 内核都按数据库自动注册知识服务；应用内对话和 MCP 用同一个检索工具定义。
- 谁受益：制度库变大后还能找准制度；托管云和开源用户都能用；知识库、合同、客户纪要这类应用不写代码就能配检索；BrightRule 不再需要自写的向量代码和派生镜像。
- 什么时候做：按 BrightRule 的定位评测结论排期（制度多到多少份时读目录不够用），不抢「员工能问制度」（M1）。现在只立两份 ADR，其余是表格行，开工时再拆卡。
- 需要你做的：合并两份 ADR（objectstack-ai/cloud#4960 与子卡 1）。

## Rulings that bound every child

- A key lands with its first reader in the same PR (ADR-0049); no type or key ships without its enforcer.
- Answers read content as the asking user; the index copy is for ranking and snippets only.
- Embedding is egress: a source lists its content fields explicitly.
- One `search_knowledge` definition for every transport (ADR-0149 D2).

## Done when

A knowledge source written as metadata builds and searches Chinese text on (a) `os dev`, (b) a hosted environment, (c) an enterprise PostgreSQL deployment ((b) and (c) verified on the cloud cards); the MCP door and the in-app agent serve byte-identical `search_knowledge` definitions.

Exception note (pm:epic on a cross-layer line): opened by the maintainer's words above; territory = `packages/services/service-knowledge`, `packages/plugins/knowledge-*`, `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-*`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-*`, `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`.
